_deal: The local test node, until he plays it.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-30 07:10 "Ahh our poi has flooded gas, turn of the valves. Talk to npc on traveling, turn off the valve at centre. Loads of hazards placed in POI"
_note: THE FLOODED SITE. A main valve stuck open in the night and the whole site filled with gas. The crew got out to
the edge. Talk to the crew lead where you arrive, then cross the site to the valve at its centre and shut it.
THE GAS IS THE LEVEL: hazard zones spread across the site, so the walk in is the job, not the valve.
Not MB54a (three vents from terminals, no hazard placed): this is the hazard part's first natural home
(home-office office/projects/delves/mission-parts.md, section D, place.hazard; his 10-29 "we can place hazard zones").
STAND-INS, Eliza's: (1) place.hazards, many zones across the site from the start; (2) the talk at an EDGE marker,
where he arrives, not the centre; (3) residents 'evacuated': the site's own people moved out to her, which is
what person.company does today (they stand round her at the edge). Without (3) the site's residents would be
standing in the gas, which every line here says they are not. Pay: med.

place._theme: A quiet built site people work: theirs, now full of gas.
place._residents: STAND-IN: the site's own people are not in the gas; the crew are her company at the edge. Eliza's.
place._hazards: STAND-IN: gas hazard zones scattered across the site from the start, cleared (or left to thin) when the valve shuts. Whether they clear on stage 2 is his call on play.

prose.name: Danger: Gas Flood on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A valve at the <Place> stuck open in the night and flooded the whole site with gas. The crew got out to the edge. Somebody has to walk in and shut it.

beats._at: STAND-IN: a marker at the site's edge, where he arrives. Eliza's to pick.
beats.objective: Talk to the crew lead at the edge of the <Place>
beats.journal: The whole <Place> is full of gas from a valve that stuck open. I need to cross the site and shut the main valve at the centre.

person.name: Dagny Halloran
hellos: Don't go in there without your helmet. I mean it.

company._list: STAND-IN: the site's crew, unarmed, standing round her. A civilian worker list, Eliza's.

greeting: You're here about the gas? The main valve stuck open in the night and filled the whole site. We got out. The valve's in the middle, of course.

reply: It's a big red wheel, you can't miss it. Breathe through your suit, and don't stop to look around.

exchanges.prompt: What's in the gas? I can tell you how long it'll hang.
reply: Nobody's told us. If you know, I'd rather hear it from you than from my lungs.
No. Everyone's out here with me. I counted twice.
A seal went. Then the alarm went. Then the alarm went quiet, which was worse.
Not in these suits. Nobody here is going back in without a better one.

beats._model: A large valve or wheel static at the centre, his or Kim's pick; MB54a's terminal is the fallback.
beats.name: Main Valve
beats.objective: Shut the main valve at the centre of the <Place>

message.title: Main Valve
message.text: The wheel fights for half a turn, then gives. The hissing stops.

beats.journal: I crossed the <Place> through the gas and shut the main valve. It will take a while to clear, but it has stopped coming.
say: It's gone quiet. You did it. We'll give it an hour before anyone goes back in.

broadcast: If you're near the site, don't go straight in. It's full of gas. We're at the edge, come and find us first.
_speech: Dagny, on the radio and in person: practical, shaken, counting heads. MB52a's voice as a stand-in; his ear decides.
